SELECT  "t0"."code" AS "code",
"t0"."id" AS "pkey"
 FROM "invc"."invc_product" AS t0
WHERE (
                ((:lo IS NULL AND :hi IS NOT NULL AND "t0"."unit_price"<=:hi) OR
                (:lo IS NOT NULL AND :hi IS NULL AND "t0"."unit_price">=:lo) OR
                (:lo IS NOT NULL AND :hi IS NOT NULL AND
                    "t0"."unit_price" >= :lo AND "t0"."unit_price" <= :hi) OR
                (:lo IS NULL AND :hi IS NULL))
            ) AND ("t0"."__del_ts" IS NULL)
